Based on the clinical information provided, I would recommend the following CPT codes:

1. 63048 - Laminectomy, facetectomy and foraminotomy (unilateral or bilateral with decompression of spinal cord, cauda equina and/or nerve root[s], [e.g., spinal or lateral recess stenosis]), single vertebral segment; lumbar
This code would cover the left anterior retroperitoneal spine exposure, L5-S1 diskectomy, and re-instrumentation using the 4WEB textured titanium femoral ring-type interbody device.

2. 22845 - Anterior instrumentation; 2 to 3 vertebral segments (List separately in addition to code for primary procedure)
This code would cover the anterior spinal instrumentation buttress plate with a single screw into the sacrum.

3. 77002 - Fluoroscopic guidance for needle placement (e.g., biopsy, aspiration, injection, localization device)
This code would cover the fluoroscopic localization of the spine.

The use of BMP sponges and manufactured bone graft would be considered part of the procedure and not separately billable.

It's important to note that the coding recommendations are based on the information provided in the clinical chart summary, and it's always recommended to review the complete medical records and consult with the provider to ensure the most accurate and appropriate coding.
